# Data Source: tfe_teams

Gets information on teams. The teams returned may be a subset of all teams in an organization based on the permissions of the API token.

## Example Usage

```csharp
using Constructs;
using HashiCorp.Cdktf;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
using Gen.Providers.Tfe;
class MyConvertedCode : TerraformStack
{
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, string name) : base(scope, name)
    {
        new DataTfeTeams.DataTfeTeams(this, "foo", new DataTfeTeamsConfig {
            Organization = "my-org-name"
        });
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `Organization` (String) Name of the organization.

### Read-Only

- `Id` (String) Name of the organization.
- `Ids` (Map of String) A map of team names in an organization and their IDs.
- `Names` (List of String) A list of team names in an organization.
